id.heroTitle: Satu kalimat, satu coretan, seribu tawa.
id.heroSub: Tiap pemain memulai satu album. Album itu berpindah tangan: kamu melanjutkan cerita atau gambar milik orang lain. Di akhir, semua album diputar sebagai slideshow — dan biasanya hasilnya kacau dengan cara yang lucu.
id.name: Nama kamu
id.practiceSub: Main tanpa server lawan bot yang menulis kalimat ngaco dan mencoret bentuk sederhana. Di lobby latihan kamu juga bisa menambah pemain lokal untuk main gantian di satu perangkat.
id.onlineOff: Main online hanya bisa di sambungcoret.jadidaring.com. Mode latihan tetap bisa dimainkan di sini.
id.onlineDisabled: Server online sedang tidak tersedia. Coba lagi nanti, atau main latihan dulu.
id.onlineReady: Online siap! Buat room, gabung pakai kode, atau cari match publik.
how: Host memilih mode (Cerita berlanjut atau Gambar berlanjut), panjang album (putaran atau giliran) dan timer, lalu menekan Mulai.
Setiap pemain punya satu album. Jadi 5 pemain = 5 album yang berjalan bersamaan, dan hasil akhirnya 1 album per pemain.
Tiap langkah, semua pemain mengerjakan satu album di saat yang sama. Begitu semua selesai (atau waktu habis), album bergeser ke pemain berikutnya — kamu selalu melanjutkan milik orang lain.
Selesai lebih cepat? Tunggu sebentar sampai yang lain selesai. Kalau waktu habis, tulisanmu yang sudah diketik tetap dikirim otomatis; yang kosong diisi bot (ditandai otomatis).
Setelah langkah terakhir, semua album diputar sebagai slideshow: siapa menulis/menggambar apa, langkah demi langkah. Host bisa memandu slideshow, lalu Main lagi.
id.modeCeritaDesc: Pemilik album menulis kalimat pembuka. Pemain berikutnya hanya melihat kalimat terakhir (bukan seluruh cerita) lalu menambah satu kalimat (maks. 160 huruf). Begitu terus sampai album selesai — kalimat terakhir jadi penutup. Cerita lengkap baru terlihat di slideshow akhir.
id.modeGambarDesc: Pemilik album menulis judul (maks. 48 huruf). Lalu tiap pemain melihat judul + kanvas yang sudah ada dan menambah coretan di kanvas yang sama (tidak dihapus). Ada kuas, penghapus, ember cat, warna, ukuran, undo dan hapus coretanku. Tinta tiap giliran terbatas supaya room tetap ringan.
lenHow: 1 putaran (default) = setiap album disentuh tiap pemain tepat satu kali. Cerita: N pemain → N kalimat per album (pemilik menulis pembuka).
Gambar, 1 putaran: pemilik menulis judul, lalu N giliran gambar — dimulai pemain berikutnya, dan pemilik menutup dengan coretan terakhir. Jadi tiap orang menggambar di setiap album satu kali.
2 atau 3 putaran = rotasinya diulang 2× / 3× (album makin panjang).
Giliran tetap (3 / 5 / 8 / 12) = panjang album tidak bergantung jumlah pemain. Di mode Gambar, judul tidak termasuk hitungan giliran.
Contoh 4 pemain: Cerita 1 putaran = 4 langkah; Gambar 1 putaran = 1 judul + 4 gambar = 5 langkah.
id.footerNote: Game gratis di browser. Tanpa akun, tanpa top-up.
id.platformNote: Jadidaring hanya penyedia platform. Isi cerita dan gambar dibuat oleh para pemain.
id.localNote: Pemain lokal main bergantian di perangkat ini: saat gilirannya, serahkan HP/laptop lalu tekan “Mulai”. Jangan intip ya!
id.lenNoteG: = 1 judul + {L} giliran gambar per album ({S} langkah, {n} pemain).
id.needTwo: Butuh minimal 2 pemain (boleh bot atau pemain lokal).

id.titleSub: Semua pemain akan menggambar judul ini bergantian di satu kanvas. Makin aneh makin seru!
id.inkEmpty: Tinta giliran ini habis — tekan Selesai.
id.handSub: Pemain lain jangan ngintip! Timer mulai saat tombol ditekan.

en.heroKicker: Party game for 2–8 players · telephone style
en.heroTitle: One sentence, one scribble, a thousand laughs.
en.heroSub: Every player starts one album. Albums change hands: you continue somebody else's story or drawing. At the end every album plays back as a slideshow — usually gloriously off the rails.
en.name: Your name
en.practiceSub: Play without a server against bots that write silly sentences and doodle simple shapes. In the practice lobby you can also add local players and pass one device around.
en.onlineOff: Online play only works on sambungcoret.jadidaring.com. Practice still works here.
en.onlineDisabled: The online server is unavailable right now. Try again later, or practice first.
en.onlineReady: Online ready! Create a room, join with a code, or find a public match.
how: The host picks the mode (Story chain or Drawing chain), the album length (laps or turns) and timers, then presses Start.
Every player owns one album. 5 players = 5 albums running at the same time, and the end result is 1 album per player.
On each step everyone works on one album at the same time. When everyone is done (or time runs out) the albums shift to the next player — you always continue someone else's.
Finished early? Wait a moment for the others. When time runs out whatever you typed is sent automatically; empty slots are filled by a bot (marked auto).
After the last step every album plays as a slideshow: who wrote/drew what, step by step. The host can drive the slideshow, then Play again.
en.modeCeritaDesc: The album owner writes an opening sentence. The next player sees only the last sentence (not the whole story) and adds one sentence (max 160 characters). Repeat until the album is done — the last sentence is the ending. The full story appears only in the end slideshow.
en.modeGambarDesc: The album owner writes a title (max 48 characters). Then every player sees the title + the canvas so far and adds strokes to the same canvas (nothing is wiped). Brush, eraser, paint bucket, colours, sizes, undo and clear my strokes. Ink per turn is limited so the room stays light.
lenHow: 1 lap (default) = every album is touched by every player exactly once. Story: N players → N sentences per album (the owner writes the opener).
Drawing, 1 lap: the owner writes the title, then N drawing turns — starting with the next player, and the owner closes with the final strokes. So everyone draws on every album once.
2 or 3 laps = the rotation repeats 2× / 3× (longer albums).
Fixed turns (3 / 5 / 8 / 12) = album length does not depend on the player count. In Drawing mode the title is not counted as a turn.
Example with 4 players: Story 1 lap = 4 steps; Drawing 1 lap = 1 title + 4 drawings = 5 steps.
en.footerNote: Free browser game. No account, no top-up.
en.platformNote: Jadidaring is only the platform provider. Stories and drawings are created by the players.
en.localNote: Local players take turns on this device: on their turn, hand over the phone/laptop and press “Start”. No peeking!
en.lenNoteG: = 1 title + {L} drawing turns per album ({S} steps, {n} players).
